purpose: Independent, prospective main-study extension: compare finite-time and finite-size behaviour at symmetric and off-critical compositions under the original 0.65 Tc quench.
stop_rule: Complete the declared 16 replicas for every condition, or record a compute/storage failure. Keep every completed and unresolved trajectory. Do not extend runs or select a fitting window because a slope approaches or avoids 1/3. Compare sizes at matched times and report resolved-time attrition.
